# 2. Analysis
## 2.1 Phylum level relative abundance
```{r}
path <- paste0("qiime/combined/6_Taxonomy_GTDB/feature_table.tsv")
relab<- read.table(path , header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
colnames(relab) <- format_sample_ids(colnames(relab))

firmicutes <- c("Firmicutes","Firmicutes_A","Firmicutes_B","Firmicutes_C" )
relab_phy <- relab %>% mutate(phylum = gsub(".*p__","",taxon),
                              phylum = gsub(";c__.*", "", phylum),
                              phylum = ifelse(phylum %in% firmicutes, "Firmicutes", phylum)) %>% 
             filter(phylum != "") %>% 
             select(-taxon) %>% group_by(phylum) %>% summarise_all(sum) %>% ungroup() %>% 
             column_to_rownames("phylum") %>%  mutate_all(~ . / sum(.)) %>% 
             t() %>% as.data.frame()

relab_phy_mean <- apply(relab_phy, 2, mean)
non_rare_phyla <- relab_phy_mean[relab_phy_mean > 0.01] %>% names() %>% sort()
```

```{r}
ggdata <- relab_phy %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "ra") %>% 
          mutate(taxon = ifelse(taxon %in% non_rare_phyla, taxon, "Other")) %>%
          group_by(sample_id, taxon) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
          inner_join(mdata_all,by = "sample_id") %>% 
          group_by(patient_id ,phenotype, phenotype_binary, taxon )  %>% summarise(ra = mean(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))

tmp_palette <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9,name = 'RdYlGn'))(length(non_rare_phyla))
names(tmp_palette) <- non_rare_phyla
tmp_palette["Other"] <- "grey"

ggdata <- ggdata %>% mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(non_rare_phyla, "Other")))
```
```{r}
phylum_ra <- plot_abundance_barplot(ggdata, tmp_palette) + 
  facet_grid(~phenotype, scales = "free_x", space = "free") + labs(fill = "Phylum") + 
        theme_classic(base_size = 10)  +
        theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
              strip.background =element_rect(fill="grey95"),
                strip.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "top") + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4))
phylum_ra
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=12, fig.align='center'}
test_data <- ggdata_for_boxplot %>% left_join(patient_mdata %>% select(all_of(c("patient_id", regressors))), by = "patient_id") 
result <- data.frame()
for (taxa in unique(test_data$taxon)){
  taxon_result <- perm_ancova_pairs(df = test_data %>% filter(taxon == taxa), 
                     X = "ra", group =  "phenotype_binary", covariates = regressors) %>% add_significance("p_value_perm_pair") %>% 
                  mutate(feature = taxa)

}
result

                       aes(x = taxon, y = ra, fill = phenotype_binary, color = phenotype_binary)) + 
                plot_box_and_jitter(palette, legend_position = "top") + ylim(-0.01, 0.9) +

phyla_ra_box
```

```{r}
calculate_phyla_ratio <- function(df,  num, denom){
  phyla_ratio <- df %>% filter(taxon %in% c(num, denom)) %>% 
                 mutate(phyla_group = ifelse(taxon %in% num, "numerator", "denominator")) %>% 
                 group_by(patient_id,phenotype_binary,phenotype, phyla_group) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
                 tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = phyla_group, values_from = ra) %>% 
                 mutate(ratio = numerator/denominator)
  return (phyla_ratio)
}
```


```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4, fig.align='center'}
num <- c("Firmicutes")
denom <- c("Bacteroidota")

res <- calculate_phyla_ratio(ggdata_for_boxplot, num, denom) %>% 
       mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order),
              log2_ratio = log2(ratio))#, patient_id = paste(patient_id, "Cohort"))

res %>% group_by(phenotype) %>% summarise(mean_ratio = mean(ratio))

regressors <- c("bmi", "age", "gender")
ggdata <- res %>% left_join(patient_mdata %>% select(all_of(c("patient_id", regressors))), by = "patient_id")
perm_ancova_pairs(df = ggdata, X = "ratio", group =  "phenotype", covariates = regressors) %>% add_significance("p_value_perm_pair")

fb_ratio <- ggplot(res, aes(phenotype, log2_ratio, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
             plot_box_and_jitter(palette) + 
             scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" ", "\n" ,x)) + 
             ylim(min(res$log2_ratio)-0.1, 1.1*max(res$log2_ratio)) + # leave space for significance starts
             theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) + 
            labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "F/B Ratio [log2]")
plot(fb_ratio)

```

## 2.2 Alpha diversity

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10, fig.align='center'}
alpha_div_metrics <- c("shannon",  "simpson")
ancova <- data.frame()
ggp_list <- list()

for (metric in alpha_div_metrics){
  ## Data preparation
  div <- vegan::diversity(taxa_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), index = metric)
  div_df <- data.frame(sample_id = names(div),metric = div) %>% 
            left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id") %>% 
            mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))
  
  ancova_metric <- perm_ancova_pairs(df = div_df, X = "metric", group =  "phenotype", covariates = regressors)
  ancova <- rbind(ancova, ancova_metric %>% mutate(feature = metric))

  ## Visualization
  y_lab <- paste(stringr::str_to_title(metric), "diversity")
  
  ggp <- ggplot(div_df, aes(phenotype, metric, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
    plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) +
    labs(x = "Phenotype", y = y_lab) + theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" ", "\n" ,x)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) + 
    ylim(min(div_df$metric)*0.95, max(div_df$metric)*1.1) # leave space for sig starts

  ggp_list[[metric]] <- ggp
}
ancova  %>% add_significance(pval_col = "p_value_perm_pair")
ggp_list[["shannon"]]
ggp_list[["simpson"]]

```


## 2.3 Beta diversity
```{r}
  genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(taxa_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), method = "bray") %>% 
                as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
  tmp <- genus_dist %>% left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id")
  bd <- vegan::betadisper(d = as.dist(tmp %>% select(tmp$sample_id)), group = unname(tmp$phenotype), bias.adjust = TRUE)
  abd <- anova(bd)
  pbd <- vegan::permutest(bd, permutations = 999)
  print(abd)
  print(pbd)
```

```{r}
res <- get_permanova(disct_metadata = mdata %>% mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order)),  
                      dist_matrix = genus_dist,
                      dist_metric_name = "Bray-Curtis",
                      sample_id_column = 'sample_id', 
                      metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype"),
                      fdr_threshold = 0.1,
                      pcoa_fill = palette)

beta_div <- res$plots[["phenotype_pc1&pc2"]] + 
           labs(fill = "", title = "", color = "") + 
           theme(legend.position = c(0.8,0.15),
                 legend.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA))  + coord_fixed() 
beta_div
```

## 2.4 Genus level relative abundance

```{r}
## Compare Control subjects to FAP patients from both classical and non-classical FAP
labels <- c("FAP", "Control")
fap_vs_control <- get_differential_abundance(taxa_df, 
                  mdata %>% mutate(phenotype_binary = factor(phenotype_binary, levels = labels)),
                                             metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype_binary"),
                                             metadata_cols_fix_effects = regressors)
  
ggdata <- fap_vs_control$all_results %>% filter(! metadata %in% regressors) %>% 
           mutate(is_significant = FDR < 0.05, 
           is_coef = abs(coef) > 1,
           is_highlight = is_significant & is_coef,
           label = ifelse(is_highlight, feature, ""),
           color = ifelse(is_highlight & coef < 1, labels[[1]], labels[[2]]),
           color = ifelse(!is_highlight,"Non-Significant", color))

#ggdata <- prepare_maaslin2_for_volcano(fap_vs_control$all_results, metadata_vars = c("phenotype_binary"))
volcano <- plot_volcano(ggdata, n_label_overlaps = 7, label_size = 3,fdr_min = 0.05 ) + 
         scale_color_manual(values = palette) + 
         theme(legend.position = "top") 
volcano
maaslin_features <- ggdata %>% select(feature, color) %>% 
                                 mutate(feature_name = feature, feature_type = "Genus") %>% 
                                 rename(`maaslin taxonomy` = color) 
#write.csv(maaslin_features, "figures/f1/f1_feature_lists.csv",  row.names = F)
```

### 2.4.1 Box plots for supplementary
```{r}
target_genera <- ggdata %>% filter(is_highlight) %>% add_sigstars(fdr_p_value = "FDR")
ann_df <- target_genera %>% select(feature, significance)

fap_genera <- target_genera %>% filter(coef < 0) %>% pull(feature)
control_genera <- target_genera %>% filter(coef > 0) %>% pull(feature)
target_genera <- target_genera %>% pull(feature)

ggdata_boxplot <- taxa_df %>% select(sample_id, target_genera ) %>% 
                  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "feature", values_to = "ra") %>% 
                  left_join(mdata_all, by = "sample_id") %>% 
                  mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))


```

```{r}
nrows <- 3
ann_df <- ggdata %>% filter(is_significant) %>% arrange(desc(color), FDR) %>% 
          add_sigstars(fdr_p_value = "FDR") %>% 
          group_by(color) %>%
          mutate(facet_group = ntile(row_number(), nrows ),
                facet_group = ifelse(color == "FAP", 0, facet_group), 
                group1 = "FAP", group2 = "Control",  ) %>% ungroup() %>% 
          group_by(facet_group) %>% 
          mutate(xmin = rank(row_number()) - 0.4, xmax = xmin + 0.8) %>% ungroup()

ann_df <- ann_df %>% left_join(ggdata_boxplot %>% group_by(feature) %>% 
                    summarise(y_val = 0.05 + max(ra)), by ="feature") %>% 
          mutate(group1 = "FAP", group2 = "Control")
```

```{r}
data <- ggdata_boxplot %>%
        left_join(ann_df %>% select(feature, facet_group), by = "feature") %>% 
        mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = ann_df$feature))
```

```{r, fig.width= 10, fig.height=7}
ggp <- ggplot(data, aes(feature, ra, color = phenotype_binary, fill = phenotype_binary)) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) + 
  facet_wrap(~facet_group, scales = "free_y") + 
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(ann_df,
    label = "significance",
    xmin = "xmin", xmax = "xmax",
    y.position = "y_val",

    inherit.aes = FALSE, coord.flip = T
  ) + theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_blank()) +   
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(x = "Genus", y = "Relative abundance") 
plot(ggp)
```
